sourceV3.Recommended_Action: Treat figshare/GitHub release as canonical; audit Kaggle mirror completeness before use.
sourceV3.V3_AI_Evidence_Note: Retain the six-example review's RDD2022 assignments from the version 2.0 report and its Figshare v1/paper/official-README evidence. Current README corroborates six countries, four classes, withheld test labels and a release file list. The canonical release reports 47,420 images in six countries including China, with more than 55,000 damage instances. Dataset-level CC BY 4.0 supports A3 for noncommercial research, while third-party imagery rights remain U under A4/G3. Taxonomy and annotation instructions support L1/L2. Country/class counts support C2; country/equipment context and documented limits support R1/R2 and M1/M5. Version and file lists support V1. Withheld challenge-test annotations must not be represented as publicly available labels. Country folders do not establish route-independent splits.
